title: Welcome to the TheySix community
summary: A welcome message to the growing TheySix community and a look at the work behind new Minecraft farm designs.
description: TheySix welcomed its first Discord members and shared more about the time and testing required to create reliable Minecraft farm tutorials.

body.text: Thank you to everyone who joined and supported the new community.
Creating new farm designs takes extensive building, testing and troubleshooting, especially for complex farms such as raid and wither farms.
